entry_gate: best independently replicated priority pairs/loci selected from upstream evidence and frozen before any fine-mapping or colocalization result access

input_contract.variant_universe: both summary-statistic datasets, LD rows/columns, and the variant-order file must contain the same SNPs in the same order
input_contract.allele_policy: A1 is the effect allele in both summary-statistic datasets and the signed LD matrix; strand and effect direction must be verified before lock
input_contract.sample_size_policy: record total N and effective N separately; case-control datasets must also record case fraction
input_contract.dense_data_policy: HapMap3-only or lead-variant-only inputs are prohibited

ld_contract.matrix: signed Pearson genotype correlation, symmetric and positive semidefinite with unit diagonal
ld_contract.warning: external or allele-misaligned LD can create unreliable fine-mapping signals; physical proximity is not a substitute for LD

fine_mapping.functional_prior_policy: Flat-prior SuSiE-RSS is primary. PolyFun-derived per-variant prior weights may be a prespecified sensitivity only when the genome-wide annotation model, ancestry, build, source commit, and output checksum are locked before locus result access.
fine_mapping.finemap_policy: FINEMAP is an optional complementary sensitivity only after an explicit locus-level justification, pinned executable/version, identical variant universe and LD, and pre-result lock; it is never silently substituted for SuSiE-RSS.

comparisons.molecular_qtl_policy: Every eQTL, sQTL, and pQTL modality must have either one or more checksum-locked compatible analyses or an evidence-backed NO_SUITABLE_DATASET row; unavailable modalities are retained, not dropped.
comparisons.context_policy: tissue, cell type, molecular feature, phenotype definition, ancestry, build, sample size, license, and sample overlap must be recorded before result access

hypotheses.H0: neither dataset is associated in the region
hypotheses.H3: both datasets are associated through distinct variants
hypotheses.H4: both datasets are associated through a shared variant model

colocalization.primary_shared_signal_rule: PP.H4 >= 0.80 and PP.H4 / PP.H3 >= 5 at p12=1e-5, with converged fine maps, no kriging allele-switch outlier, and no LD QC failure
colocalization.prior_robust_rule: the primary shared-signal rule holds at every locked p12 sensitivity value
colocalization.single_signal_fallback: coloc.abf may be reported as COLOC_ABF_FALLBACK only when either SuSiE dataset has no credible set and the single-causal-variant assumption is explicitly justified; fallback evidence cannot be labelled multi-signal colocalization

claim_limit: Fine-mapping PIPs and credible sets are model-based probabilities. Colocalization supports a shared-signal model under stated data, LD, and priors; it does not prove a causal variant, gene, pathway, mediation direction, or biological mechanism.
